name: Item scaling: Worldforged chest items stay their authored entries for a level-scaled character
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1, DestinyWeaver.Scaling.Offset=3, CoA.ItemScaling=1 and mod-worldforged-upgrades. Issue #6767: the Guardian of Time offers an upgrade only for the exact base item entry, so a Worldforged item must never be replaced by a lifted copy. Theramore Equipment 254582 holds Theramore Girdle 354518 (green, item level 40, description @Worldforged@) at 100%; a level 60 character with open-world scaling on meets content at level 57, which would lift any other green by 15 levels. Harvest Golem Scythe 1345068 holds Harvest Golem Scythe 450560 (blue, item level 18), an upgrade base in worldforged_upgrade whose description lacks the marker. Both must loot as their authored entries and item levels. The store window itself is not exercised.
